column1: # THE BERLIN DIRECTORY AND THE 1939 CENSUS, HOUSEHOLD BY HOUSEHOLD — 20 September 2026.
# Mapping the Lives (Tracing the Past e.V.), the memorial database built on the 1939 census
# supplementary card and allied sources, searched by surname: LEIBHOLZ RETURNS 114 PERSONS.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Today's work read the Berliner Adressbuch householder section off the page
# images and produced a list of Leibholz HOUSEHOLDERS with trades and street numbers, 1938 to 1943.
# This database holds PEOPLE with dates of birth and dates of death at STREET ADDRESSES. Laying one
# against the other turns a list of surnames into households — and, in two cases, into whole families.
# THE MATCHING RULE, AND IT IS STRICTER THAN NAME: every row below matches on STREET AND HOUSE NUMBER,
# not on surname. Berlin held four million people and this archive has twice published a person built
# out of two.

column1: ALFRED LEIBHOLZ
column2: 1940: "A ISRAEL, Fleischermeister, NW87 LEVETZOWSTRASSE 13". 1941: the same man, same address, no longer a Fleischermeister but an ARBEITER. Absent from 1942.
column3: Leibholz, ALFRED, born 04.12.1887, DIED 08.08.1942, Levetzowstr. 13 Hinterhaus II links, Tiergarten
column4: HIS FORENAME, AND HIS DEATH. "A. Israel" was ALFRED. He was stripped of his trade in the 1941 volume and DIED ON 8 AUGUST 1942, which is why the 1942 volume has no entry for him. AND HE IS NOT ALONE AT THAT ADDRESS — the database gives four more Leibholz at Levetzowstraße 13: ELSE née SEELIG, born 20.07.1889, died 17-19.08.1943; KURT, born 04.11.1927, died before 08.05.1945; LIESELOTTE, born 16.11.1923, died 06.12.1943; MARIANNE, born 26.04.1921. A MASTER BUTCHER, HIS WIFE AND THREE CHILDREN, IN ONE BACK-BUILDING FLAT.

column1: and the street should be named without decoration
column4: The LEVETZOWSTRASSE SYNAGOGUE, a few doors from number 13, was requisitioned in 1941 as the main Berlin deportation assembly camp. That is a fact about the street, not a claim about this family.

column1: HEINRICH LEIBHOLZ — AND HE IS THE CONTROL THIS WHOLE READING NEEDED
column2: in the directory 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941 and 1942 as "Heinrich, Verwaltungsbeamter, Neukölln, LEINESTRASSE 32". ABSENT FROM 1943.
column3: Leibholz, HEINRICH, born 16.10.1890, DIED 9 AUGUST 1948, Leinestr. 32 III. rechts, Neukölln — with AGNES née KERGER, born 10.03.1889, at the same address
column4: *** HE SURVIVED THE WAR. He disappears from the directory after 1942 AND HE DIED IN 1948. *** So a Leibholz vanishing from the Berliner Adressbuch DOES NOT MEAN A DEATH, and today's series — 17, 11, 10, 9, 6, 4 — cannot be read as a casualty count. It never claimed to be, and now there is a named person proving why it must not be.

column1: JACOB, WHO TRADED AS JAQUES
column2: 1938 and 1939: "JAQUES, Kaufmann, Schöneberg, MERANER STRASSE 2". Absent from 1940.
column3: Leibholz, JACOB [JAKOB], born 08.08.1884, died before 08.05.1945, Meraner Str. 2, Schöneberg
column4: THE DATABASE PRINTS BOTH FORMS OF HIS NAME. Jaques and Jacob are the same man, which today's reading inferred from the alphabetical run and can now stop inferring.

column1: AUGUSTE née LUWINSKI
column2: the 1940 directory has "AUGUSTE, WITWE, Schöneberg, BADENSCHE STRASSE 9" and nothing in any other year.
column3: Leibholz, AUGUSTE née LUWINSKI, born 28.08.1893, Meraner Str. 2, Schöneberg
column4: *** AND THIS DOES NOT RESOLVE IT. *** The database puts Lizzy at MERANER STRASSE 2 with Jacob. The 1940 directory widow is at BADENSCHE STRASSE 9, a different street, and calls her a widow three years before Jacob was deported. NO LEIBHOLZ AT BADENSCHE STRASSE 9 APPEARS IN THE DATABASE AT ALL. The two are still not joined and this archive is still not joining them.

column3: Leibholz, FELIX, born 19.06.1877, Scharnhorststr. 25, Mitte — with MARTHA née RIEDE, born 17.04.1871, same address

column4: A SECOND BUTCHER'S FAMILY. Wilhelm the Fleischermeister of Lenaustraße is a different man from Alfred of Levetzowstraße, and his wife and a son of twenty both died before the end of the war.

column2: 1938: "Arthur, Dr. med., Sanitätsrat, SO16 Köpenicker Straße 91".
column4: HE WAS ALREADY DEAD when the 1938 volume was printed — directories are compiled a year ahead and carry the dead for a year. A caution for every other entry in this file.

column3: Leibholz, GEORG, born 07.06.1884, died 13.05.1942, Michaelkirchstr. 26, Mitte — with LIEDIA [LYDIA] née PERL, born 16.01.1885, died 13.05.1942, same address

column1: # ——— THE TWO RECORDS THAT MATTER MOST, READ IN FULL, 20 September 2026 ———
AUGUSTE LEIBHOLZ née LUWINSKI — KURT'S MOTHER, AND THE RECORD ANSWERS THREE QUESTIONS AT ONCE
column2: 1939 census supplementary card, Reichssippenamt, Bundesarchiv R 1509
column3: born 28.08.1893 in SAUERBAUM / RÖSSEL / OSTPREUSSEN · residence 17.05.1939 Meraner Str. 2, Schöneberg · "Race": NNNN · Basis of persecution: COLLECTIVE
column4: see the four rows below.

column1: (1) HER BIRTHPLACE IS NAMED, AND THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY KNEW THE VILLAGE
column3: SAUERBAUM, KREIS RÖSSEL, EAST PRUSSIA — in the Ermland
column4: JOHANNA THIMM OF SAUERBAUM IS KURT'S GREAT-GRANDMOTHER, and this archive used the Thimm surname as its control when counting Berlin directory pages precisely because she was East Prussian and not Jewish. LIZZY WAS BORN IN THE SAME VILLAGE. The East Prussia page has been built on Ermland parish entries; here is the village, from a 1939 state document.

column1: (2) "RACE": NNNN
column3: the Ergänzungskarte recorded the ancestry of all four grandparents. N is nicht-jüdisch. FOUR N's MEANS ALL FOUR GRANDPARENTS WERE RECORDED AS NON-JEWISH.
column4: SO THE GERMAN STATE ITSELF CLASSIFIED LIZZY AS NOT JEWISH, on its own form, in 1939. That is the first documentary answer to a question this archive has carried for weeks.

column1: (3) "BASIS OF PERSECUTION: COLLECTIVE"
column3: the term for a person persecuted as part of a household rather than for their own recorded ancestry
column4: THIS IS A MISCHEHE — a mixed marriage. Jacob was born at Schubin and was Jewish; Auguste was NNNN. It is the standard explanation for why Jacob was not deported until 26 FEBRUARY 1943, the date of the Fabrikaktion, when Berlin Jews in mixed marriages were finally seized. THE ARCHIVE STATES THE CATEGORY, WHICH IS ON THE RECORD, AND NOT THE INFERENCE THAT FOLLOWS FROM IT.

column1: (4) AND IT GIVES JACOB A PLACE OF DEATH
column3: the record's Family members block: "Leibholz, Jacob [Jakob], * 08.08.1884 in Szubin (Schubin) / Schubin / Polen, † before 08.05.1945 IN AUSCHWITZ"
column4: THE BUNDESARCHIV GEDENKBUCH ENTRY FOR JACOB SAYS "not documented" FOR BOTH DEATH DATE AND DEATH PLACE, and data/leibholz-gedenkbuch.tsv carries that. THIS SOURCE NAMES AUSCHWITZ. The date remains undocumented.

column1: SIEGFRIED LEIBHOLZ
column3: the same Family members block: "Leibholz, Siegfried, * 05.08.1925 in Berlin / Berlin, † -"
column4: Jacob and Auguste's son, KURT'S HALF-BROTHER through their mother. NO DEATH IS RECORDED FOR HIM IN THIS DATABASE — which is not the same as surviving, and is not treated here as if it were.

column1: AND THE QUESTION IT SHARPENS RATHER THAN ANSWERS
column4: KURT WAS BORN IN 1912 AND LIZZY MARRIED JACOB IN 1924, so Kurt is her son by another man and Jacob was his stepfather. If Lizzy was NNNN, then KURT'S CLASSIFICATION AS A JEW — he carried the imposed name ISRAEL out of Germany in 1933 — CANNOT HAVE COME FROM HER. It came from the father whose surname he does not carry. THIS ARCHIVE HAS NO NAME FOR THAT MAN AND IS NOT GUESSING ONE.

column1: ANTON LUWINSKI — read in full, and one of this archive's assumptions corrected
column2: 1939 census supplementary card, ID no. VZ280665
column3: born 16.10.1919 in DEUTHEN / ALLENSTEIN / OSTPREUSSEN · residence 17.05.1939 at the Lehrwerkstatt Ostpreußisches Baugewerbe, Schindekopstr. 7, Königsberg · "Race": NNNN · Basis of persecution: UNKNOWN
column4: DEUTHEN IS IN KREIS ALLENSTEIN, IN THE ERMLAND — the same Catholic corner of East Prussia as Sauerbaum, about twenty miles away. A twenty-year-old apprentice in the building trade at Königsberg. AND THE CORRECTION: a work-list row written an hour earlier called this "a persecution database" and inferred something from his being in it. HIS CARD SAYS NNNN AND "BASIS OF PERSECUTION: UNKNOWN". The database indexes surviving 1939 census cards, and being in it is not evidence of persecution. NOTHING CONNECTS HIM TO LIZZY BUT A RARE SURNAME AND A SMALL PROVINCE — but they are now two Luwinskis from two Ermland villages, which is a better reason to look than it was.
